notes.title: Improved English translation on update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174568/1d489cd439e0cb9299320beee0de99ed55cb6b52.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!
This is an update (Ver. 1.01) of "The Villainess is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom".
It includes fixes.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to users who enjoy this service in English.
We have reviewed the overall translation in this update.
We will continue to update the game as we review our development system.
Please continue to support "The Villainess is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom".
This update includes minor bug fixes.
